content.short: Trust Wallet is a self custody multi-chain wallet for assets, swaps, NFTs, dapps, and TON support inside a broader Web3 app.
content.description: Trust Wallet is a self custody wallet available on mobile and browser extension, built for users who want one app for assets across many blockchains. It supports token storage, swaps, NFT management, staking features, and connections to decentralized applications through a familiar multi-chain interface. In the TON ecosystem, it works as a general purpose wallet option for people who want access to TON alongside many other networks, rather than a wallet designed only for TON native workflows and product integrations.
content.meta: Trust Wallet gives users self custody access to assets, swaps, NFTs, dapps, and TON support inside a wider multi-chain wallet experience.

resources.title: An Agent Kit for Non-Custodial Wallets
resources.tldr: Letting an AI agent hold value and pay for things without handing custody to a service. The permission design is the hard part and this engages with it.
